title: 第7章 月黑风高杀人夜第8章 校尉之死京城名捕
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 夜色如墨。
陈然站在狱卒房的窗前，看着窗外漆黑的天空。
消化完三年功力后，他顺利突破了九品炼皮瓶颈，来到了八品易筋境初期。
陈然感受着体内涌动的内力，《翻云掌》的招式在脑海中一遍遍演练。
“这掌法，有点意思。”
陈然随手挥出一掌。
空气震荡，发出一声闷响。
虽然只是入门，但这威力已经远超寻常的三流武学。
若是练到大成……
陈然眼中闪过一丝精光。
就在这时。
沉闷的脚步声在走廊里响起。
陈然收回手，转身看向门口。
门被推开。
王校尉那张阴沉的脸出现在门口。
他身后跟着两个心腹狱卒，手里提着灯笼，火光摇曳，映照得他的脸色更加难看。
“还没死？”
王校尉目光在陈然身上扫了一圈，眼中闪过一丝意外。
这丁字号的煞气，就算是九品武者待久了也得脱层皮。
这小子不仅没死，反而看起来精神更好了？
“托大人的福，属下命硬。”
陈然抱拳，语气平淡。
王校尉冷哼一声，迈步走进房间。
他在房间里转了一圈，像是在视察领地的土狗，最后停在陈然面前。
“最近天牢不太平。”
王校尉盯着陈然的眼睛，声音阴冷。
“红莲魔教的人随时可能来劫狱。”
“你给我盯紧了那个妖女。”
“若是出了差错……”
他伸出手，拍了拍陈然的肩膀。
“你知道后果。”
陈然没有什么动作。
只是眼底深处，闪过一丝寒芒。
“属下明白。”
“明白就好。”
王校尉收回手，在衣服上擦了擦，仿佛碰了什么脏东西。
“好好干，别让我失望。”
说完，他转身离去。
临出门前，又回头看了一眼陈然，嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度。
“不过我看你也活不到那个时候。”
“这丁字号的煞气，可不是那么好受的。”
“自求多福吧。”
脚步声渐渐远去。
content_en:
The night is as dark as ink.
Chen Ran stood in front of the window of the jailer's room, looking at the dark sky outside the window.
After digesting three years of skills, he successfully broke through the ninth-level skin refining bottleneck and reached the early stage of the eighth-level tendon-changing realm.
Chen Ran felt the internal force surging in his body and rehearsed the moves of "Cloud Turning Palm" over and over in his mind.
"This palm technique is a bit interesting."
Chen Ran waved a palm casually.
The air vibrated, making a muffled sound.
Although it is just a beginner's level, its power is far beyond that of ordinary third-rate martial arts.
If you practice to a great extent...
A glint flashed in Chen Ran's eyes.
Just then.
"Dong-dong-dong-"
Dull footsteps sounded in the corridor.
Chen Ran took back his hand and turned to look at the door.
The door was pushed open.
Colonel Wang's gloomy face appeared at the door.
Behind him were two confidant jailers, holding lanterns in their hands. The flickering light of the fire made his face even more ugly.
"Not dead yet?"
Captain Wang glanced around Chen Ran, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
This T-shaped evil spirit will cause even a ninth-grade warrior to shed his skin after staying there for a long time.
Not only is this kid not dead, but he seems to be in better spirits?
"Thanks to my lord, my subordinates have a hard life."
Chen Ran clasped his fists and spoke calmly.
Captain Wang snorted coldly and stepped into the room.
He walked around the room like a local dog inspecting his territory, and finally stopped in front of Chen Ran.
"Tianlao has not been peaceful recently."
Captain Wang stared into Chen Ran's eyes, his voice cold.
"People from the Red Lotus Demon Sect may come to rob the prison at any time."
"Keep an eye on that witch for me."
"If something goes wrong..."
He reached out and patted Chen Ran on the shoulder.
"You know the consequences."
Chen Ran didn't make any move.
There was just a hint of coldness in the depths of his eyes.
"My subordinate understands."
"Just understand."
Colonel Wang took back his hand and wiped it on his clothes, as if he had touched something dirty.
"Do a good job and don't let me down."
After saying that, he turned and left.
Before leaving the house, he looked back at Chen Ran again, with a mocking arc on his lips.
"But I don't think you will live until that time."
"This T-shaped evil spirit is not that easy to bear."
"Bless yourself."
The footsteps gradually faded away.
